candidate.analysis: Analyze /input/public_csv as a fishing-trip CSV. Compute fish caught per hour, summarize its mean and sample size, and assess whether livebait, camper, persons, and child are associated with the hourly catch rate using grouped means and simple correlations. Handle missing, nonnumeric, and nonpositive hours safely, and print concise observations only.
candidate.answer: Across 250 valid trips, visitors caught an average of 1.107 fish per hour. Livebait users had a higher mean rate (1.220 versus 0.390 without livebait), campers had a higher rate (1.347 versus 0.765), persons showed a weak positive association (Pearson r=0.218), and children showed essentially no association (r=-0.029).
